changelog.zh:
- 新增：频道实时快照预览 —— 悬停（Windows 鼠标）或聚焦（TV）频道时预览实时画面，离开/失焦自动回退为台标，可在设置中开关；需 rtp2httpd 服务端开启 video-snapshot 才能生效
- 优化：直播流起播速度与缓冲策略，并收敛非关键日志噪声
- 重构：将设置页、频道页、首页与播放器页拆分为独立组件，提升可维护性
- 优化：启动性能，并为 EPG 逻辑补充纯逻辑单元测试
- 升级：file_picker、wakelock_plus、cached_network_image、material_ui/cupertino_ui、logger 至最新稳定版
- 修复：台标渲染锯齿、EPG 跨天节目日期窗口多出空页面、EPG 自动定位滚动不准
- 修复：启动初始化失败仍跳转首页、SQLite 外键级联与脏数据、多处监听器泄漏、全局未捕获异常兜底、小窗渲染溢出、README 语言切换与字体设置不一致
changelog.en:
- New: Channel live snapshot preview - preview the live frame on hover (Windows mouse) or focus (TV), auto-fall back to the logo on leave, toggleable in Settings; requires the video-snapshot option enabled on the rtp2httpd server
- Optimization: Improved live-stream startup speed & buffering strategy, and reduced non-critical log noise
- Refactor: Split Settings, Channels, Home and Player pages into standalone components for maintainability
- Optimization: Improved startup performance; added pure-logic unit tests for EPG
- Upgraded: file_picker, wakelock_plus, cached_network_image, material_ui/cupertino_ui and logger to latest stable
- Fixed: logo aliasing, extra empty EPG page caused by overnight programs at the end of the date window, inaccurate EPG auto-scroll
- Fixed: startup no longer navigating incorrectly after init failure, SQLite FK cascade & orphan-data cleanup, listener leaks, global uncaught-exception fallback, small-window render overflow, README language-switch and font inconsistencies
